description: This Scala source file defines utility functions for handling Kubernetes volume configurations within Apache Spark's Kubernetes deployment. It includes methods for parsing volume specifications from Spark configurations, validating options, and supporting different volume types like HostPath, PVC, EmptyDir, and NFS.

methods.name: parseVolumesWithPrefix
methods.description: Extracts and parses Kubernetes volume configurations from SparkConf based on a prefix.

methods.name: getVolumeTypesAndNames
methods.description: Identifies unique pairs of volume types and names from configuration properties.

methods.name: parseVolumeSpecificConf
methods.description: Parses specific volume configuration based on volume type, supporting HostPath, PVC, EmptyDir, and NFS.

methods.name: verifyOptionKey
methods.description: Checks if a required option key exists in the options map.

methods.name: verifyMutuallyExclusiveOptionKeys
methods.description: Ensures that mutually exclusive configuration keys are not both set.

methods.name: verifySize
methods.description: Validates that volume size is at least 1024 bytes if specified.
